name: sessions_2024_01_02_to_04
note: Sessions for the dates the shared bar and label fixtures use (2024-01-02 AAPL, 2024-01-04 AKAM), which fixtures/ has no /sessions payload for. Built from TradingCalendar.sessions_in_range(regular_hours_only=False) with the same field mapping as api/routers/bars.py:list_sessions, on the read-only bar database. ext_open_ms 04:01 ET is the first bar eob, so the extended-hours lower bound is 04:00.
